narrative.overview: One atmospheric moment, a dark indigo sky with arc artwork and a Poppins greeting, then bright, orderly surfaces where the work happens and exactly one lit button. Atmosphere is spent in the hero; everywhere else the interface is quiet, exact and fast to read.
keyCharacteristics: One dark band (navigation bar into hero) above bright working surfaces.
Cyan is the action color; the one exception is the hero search button, which is hot pink. Yellow, green and red appear only in messages.
Pill-shaped actions, 16px surfaces, hairline strokes, shallow elevation.
Public Sans for reading, Poppins for the few big moments.

rules.name: The Cyan Is Action Rule
rules.body: Cyan appears only on things that can be pressed. A static element that borrows it reads as interactive.

rules.name: The Feedback Only Rule
rules.body: Yellow, green and red mark warning, success and error messages; no badge, card or accent on the in-scope pages uses them.

rules.name: The No Raw Color Rule
rules.body: Components read alias tokens from styles/_tokens.scss, never a hex or rgb value, a named color or a palette step; URL-encoded SVG data URIs carry noted copies of token colors.

rules.name: The One Source Rule
rules.body: Tokens own every color and the logo; the color and logo settings are removed from the manifest, and the React palette mirrors the tokens under a drift test.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Every interactive element shows a ring; the dark-surface ring is cyan with an indigo gap.

dos: Do use cyan with indigo text for the single primary action on a page.
Do keep text on the 4.5:1 neutrals (#6f747a or darker) and give every control a visible focus ring.
Do keep read text at 14px or larger and prose at about 70 characters per line.
Do put new colors in _tokens.scss as aliases first.
Do keep the hero and the navigation bar one continuous dark band.
donts: Don't use cyan for anything that cannot be pressed, and don't put white text on it.
Don't use yellow, green or red outside a message.
Don't nest a card inside a card.
Don't add a colored border on one side of a card, list item or alert wider than 1px.
Don't use outline: none without a replacement ring.
Don't hard-code hex, rgba or named color values (such as yellow) in the stylesheets.
Don't write a font size outside the scale: new text takes a --font-size-* token.
